findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "sjothr_risk_prepare" is 1012 chars, far longer than this server's median (202). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sjothr_tribunal · Private data: sjothr_campaigns, sjothr_campaign, sjothr_rules, sjothr_prepare, sjothr_risk_positions, sjothr_risk_prepare, sjothr_tribunal, sjothr_market, sjothr_market_prepare, sjothr_backer, sjothr_backer_prepare, fetch · Public sink: sjothr_risk_prepare.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sjothr_tribunal · Private data: sjothr_campaigns, sjothr_campaign, sjothr_rules, sjothr_prepare, sjothr_risk_positions, sjothr_risk_prepare, sjothr_tribunal, sjothr_market, sjothr_market_prepare, sjothr_backer, sjothr_backer_prepare, fetch · Public sink: sjothr_risk_prepare

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Sjothr campaigns and guides (tokenize a company, raise money for a startup, tokenized equity, milestone-based funding); returns ids for fetch." → after: "Search Sjothr campaigns, credit risk portfolios and guides (tokenize a company, raise money for a startup, tokenized equity, milestone-based funding, credit risk); returns ids for fetch."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
